title: Local Ad
one_paragraph_synopsis: Michael initiates the process of creating a commercial for Dunder Mifflin, expressing a desire for a creative and fast-paced style. He faces challenges in the production, including disagreements over ideas and decisions to do the ad in-house. The episode also features Michael's efforts to prove his creativity, interactions with office characters, and the eventual approval to produce the commercial, though the final outcome remains uncertain.
